name: ROAS Tool Kits for Meta and Google (Post & Product Catalogue + Pixel, GA4 & GTM)
author: roasmetatools

sections.description:
Maximize your return on ad spend (ROAS) by turning your WordPress site into a highly optimized data engine for Meta and Google dynamic ads.

Standard e-commerce product feeds fall short when your primary focus is content. ROAS Tool Kits is built specifically for digital publishers and traffic monetization models. It bridges the gap between publishing and ad networks by generating dynamic Meta Advantage+ catalogues and WooCommerce product catalogues.

With built-in Meta Pixel deployment, a unified Google Analytics 4 (GA4) hub, and Google Tag Manager (GTM) injection, this is the essential tracking foundation for your site.

Free Core Features

  • Content Catalogues: Generates the exact XML feed Meta requires to run Advantage+ ads to your educational blog posts.
  • Product Catalogues: Standardized WooCommerce product feed with dynamic price syncing for Google and Meta.
  • Standard Tracking Hub: Native deployment of Meta Pixel (PageView, Purchase), GA4, and GTM container scripts.

Pro Features (Premium Upgrade)

  • UTM & ROI Persistence: Save attribution data across the entire session to ensure tracking never breaks during redirects.
  • Geotargeted Consent Mode v2: Automatically stay compliant with EU/UK data laws by defaulting EEA/UK traffic to ‘denied’.
  • Anti-Bot CAPI Deduplication: Bypasses ad-blockers by sending server-side events directly to Meta.
  • SEO Title & Category Sync: Automatically pulls optimized titles from Yoast or Rank Math into your catalogues.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Configure your Meta Pixel and GA4 in the “ROAS Tool Kits” menu.
sections.changelog:
1.4.7

  • Security: Added explicit input sanitization callbacks for all dashboard settings to comply fully with WP.org repository standards.
  • Fixed: Resolved WooCommerce checkout hang issue by moving the Purchase event injection to wp_footer.
  • Fixed: Resolved XML cache key mismatch, ensuring newly published posts appear in the catalogue feed immediately.
  • Added: Native GA4 and GTM injection for all users.
  • Added: Freemius contributor and checkout routing for seamless Pro upgrades.
  • Added: UTM Persistence and CAPI UI placeholders.
  • Branding: Optimized plugin title and description for higher visibility in organic directory searches.

1.4.5

  • Initial stable release with dynamic XML feeds.
